$comment: The registry every workflow and doc in this repo reads. Adding an app means adding an entry here and a directory named for its `id`. See docs/adding-an-app.md.

apps.name: Midnite Studio
apps.tagline: A desktop workspace around a repository — git client, terminal, agents, embedded browser and forge.

apps.name: Midnite Apps
apps.tagline: The launcher: lists, installs, updates and opens every midnite app.

apps.name: Midnite Agents
apps.tagline: Chats with your agent CLIs, councils that answer together and local models, as their own app over the chats, councils and models features.

apps.name: Midnite Browser
apps.tagline: Full-window browsing, web apps, and agent-driven sessions, as their own app over the browser feature.

apps.name: Midnite Capture
apps.tagline: Screenshots, screen recordings and an opt-in clipboard history, kept on this machine, as its own app.

apps.name: Midnite Cleaner
apps.tagline: The workspace optimizer as its own app: scan memory, GPU and storage use and reclaim space.

apps.name: Midnite Coder
apps.tagline: Pull requests and reviews, CI runs, a repository's tests, its API collections and its databases, as their own app over the forge, tests, API client and Database features.

apps.name: Midnite Creator
apps.tagline: Docs and images (audio and video to follow), as their own app.

apps.name: Midnite Gamer
apps.tagline: Maps, terrain, sprites, models and games, with play-tests and the game agent loop, as their own app.

apps.name: Midnite Media
apps.tagline: A library of your own films, shows, music and photos, as its own app.

apps.name: Midnite Mind
apps.tagline: Notes you capture in a keystroke, as their own app.

apps.name: Midnite Money
apps.tagline: Stocks, crypto and a simulated portfolio as their own app: a watchlist, markets, allocation and news, over the finance feature.

apps.name: Midnite Monitor
apps.tagline: The machine monitor as its own app: CPU, memory, GPU, disk and battery, toolchain health and the crash log.

apps.name: Midnite Vault
apps.tagline: Stored secrets, forge accounts and database logins as their own app: set, rotate or remove, never read back.
